title: Mermaid Alchemist by the Lake
description: A green-skinned mermaid with a scaled tail and white patterned scarf sits at a wooden desk on a grassy hill, pouring red liquid from a flask. In the background, an orca leaps from a misty blue lake surrounded by rolling green hills, trees, and hanging purple wisteria with glowing lanterns.
prompt: A green-skinned mermaid wearing a white patterned scarf and purple scaled tail sits at a green wooden desk on a grassy hill overlooking a misty lake. She is pouring red liquid from a small flask into a glowing blue potion bottle. Papers and a quill lie on the desk. In the background an orca leaps from the blue water. Rolling green hills, silhouetted trees, and overhanging purple wisteria vines with hanging glowing lanterns complete the scene.
